instruction: The “V2 Graduation Project Thesis Formatting Requirements” document contains comments. Reformat the other document according to those comments; then regenerate a compliant table of contents on the table of contents page, with entries that automatically jump to their corresponding locations when clicked; also add page numbers centered at the bottom of the page. No page numbers are needed on any page before or including the table of contents page.

dim1: The deliverable is in .docx format and opens normally.
dim2: +5: Page setup throughout the document: A4 portrait paper, 21 cm wide and 29.7 cm high, with a 3.6 cm top margin, 3.4 cm bottom margin, 2.7 cm left margin, and 2.5 cm right margin. On Pages 1–10, all body text, images, and tables are within the left and right page margins, with no text, image, or table extending beyond the page boundaries.

+3: Page 1 cover: Fully retain “Jianghai Institute of Applied Technology” in SimSun, Chinese size No. 2, bold; “Graduation Project Outcome Report” in SimHei, Chinese size Small No. 1, bold; “(Full-Time Junior College Student)” in SimSun, Chinese size Small No. 3; and “Graduation Project Title,” “Secondary College,” “Major and Class,” “Student ID,” “Student Name,” “Advisor,” their corresponding content, and “Description of the Structural Scheme, Control Layout, and Operating Performance” in SimSun, Chinese size No. 4.

+1: For “Graduation Project Title,” “Secondary College,” “Major and Class,” “Student ID,” “Student Name,” and “Advisor,” paragraph spacing before and after is 5 pt, the Before text indent is 2.47 cm, line spacing is Exactly 25 pt, and alignment is left.
+1: Page 2 originality declaration title: The text is “Graduation Project Originality Declaration,” in SimHei, Chinese size No. 3, bold, horizontally centered, with 20 pt line spacing.

+1: Page 2 originality declaration body: Fully retain the personal declaration, source of the outcomes, and assumption of responsibility. Chinese text uses SimSun, Chinese size Small No. 4, with a 0.85 cm first-line indent and Exactly 20 pt line spacing.

+1: Page 2 signature area: Fully retain “Student Signature:” and “Date:　Year　Month　Day.” The text and the blanks to be filled in are on the same line or in adjacent areas. Paragraph spacing before is 24 pt, and line spacing is Exactly 22 pt.

+1: Page 3 table of contents title: The text is “TABLE　　OF CONTENTS,” with two full-width spaces separating the two parts of the title, in SimHei, Chinese size Small No. 3, bold, horizontally centered, with 1.5 line spacing.

+1: Page 3 automatic table of contents object: The table of contents entries can jump to their corresponding sections via Ctrl+Click, or a single click depending on the Word setting. The table of contents is a Word TOC field or an equivalent automatic table of contents object, and “Update Field” or “Update Table” can be executed from the right-click menu; it must not consist solely of ordinary text and manually entered dots. The table of contents displays, in order, “1　　Design Approach,” “2　　Design Content,” “3　　Design Process,” “4　　Work and Features,” “5　　Acknowledgments,” and “6　　References,” matching the order of the body text.

+5: Page 3 table of contents navigation: “Design Approach,” “Design Content,” “Design Process,” “Work and Features,” “Acknowledgments,” and “References” in the table of contents are all set as hyperlinks; clicking each one jumps to its corresponding body heading.

+1: Page 3 table of contents body font: Chinese text uses SimSun, Chinese size Small No. 4; English text and numerals use Times New Roman, Chinese size Small No. 4. First-level entries are bold, with two characters of space between the number and the text; second-level entries have a first-line indent of approximately 1 character and are not bold. Table of contents entries have 5 pt spacing after and Exactly 19 pt line spacing, with dot leaders between entry names and page numbers.

+1: Page 3 table of contents page-number column: The right edges of the page numbers are aligned, the actual starting page numbers of the body text are displayed, and text formats with leading zeros such as “01” and “02” are not used.

+1: Section break after Page 3: A “Next Page” section break is inserted at the end of the table of contents page so that the body page numbers are independent of the front matter; the section break must not be displayed as ordinary body text.

+3: Page-number placement: The Page 1 cover, Page 2 originality declaration, and Page 3 table of contents do not display page numbers. Beginning with Page 4, where the body text starts, Arabic page number “1” is displayed, and subsequent body page numbers increase consecutively. Page numbers are horizontally centered in the footer at the bottom of the page.

+1: Page numbers on Pages 4–10: The center of the footer displays consecutive Arabic numerals beginning with “1,” in Times New Roman, Chinese size Small No. 5, approximately 1.3—2.0 cm from the bottom edge of the page. Page numbers use Word automatic page-number fields and can be renumbered automatically after body pages are added or deleted; the numbers must not be entered manually on each page.

+1: First-level body headings: “I. Design Approach,” “II. Design Content,” “III. Design Process,” “IV. Work and Features,” and “V. Acknowledgments” on Pages 4–10 all use SimHei, Chinese size No. 4, bold, and are flush left. Approximately one blank line is retained both above and below each first-level heading. A heading does not appear alone at the bottom of a page, and at least one body paragraph follows it. All section headings use the same Word Heading 1 style or an equivalent outline level 1 so that they can be recognized by the automatic table of contents.
+1: “VI. References” is in SimHei, Chinese size Small No. 4, bold, and centered.

+3: Body paragraphs: Chinese text uses SimSun, Chinese size Small No. 4; English text and numerals use Times New Roman, Chinese size Small No. 4; the color is black. Body paragraphs have a first-line indent of 2 characters, Exactly 20 pt line spacing, 0 pt spacing before, 0 pt spacing after, and justified alignment.
+5: Images on Pages 4–9: Figures 1–7 all remain clear, are horizontally centered, and are approximately 10—13 cm wide and 5—10 cm high.

+5: Captions for Figures 1–7: The captions appear below their corresponding images and are displayed in order from “Figure 1 Appearance Structure of the Foldable Warehouse Transport Cart” through “Figure 7 Overall Machine Module Relationships,” in SimHei, Chinese size No. 5, and horizontally centered. Each image and its corresponding caption remain on the same page; an image must not appear on one page with its caption alone on the following page.
+1: Page 5 module table caption: Add or retain the text “Table 1 Main Modules and Key Design Points” above the module table, in SimHei, Chinese size No. 5, and horizontally centered.

+5: Page 5 module table: The table is an editable 3-column by 5-row Word table. Its headers, in order, are “Module,” “Main Function,” and “Key Design Points,” followed by 4 records for the load-bearing box, subframe, suspension wheel assembly, and control panel. Text within the table uses SimSun, Chinese size No. 5; the headers are bold; and English text and numerals use Times New Roman, Chinese size No. 5. The outer border and all internal horizontal and vertical lines are continuous and complete, and the text is vertically centered.

+1: Page 10 references body: There are 4 reference entries. Chinese text uses SimSun, Chinese size No. 5; English text and numerals use Times New Roman, Chinese size No. 5; and entries are flush left.
+1: Page 10 reference numbering: The references are numbered consecutively as [1], [2], [3], and [4], in that order; bullets are not used in place of the numbers.
